F-DOC08 closes the bounded temporal-acceptance relation-to-test graph. F-DOC09 qualifies a bounded Full Richards reference-route verification evidence inventory. Complete equation-to-test graphs remain unestablished for the entire RB1 denominator and for the entire Full Richards route.
